title: MDP frontmatter
_note: Placeholder stub. This describes only the .mdp frontmatter block and is intentionally incomplete. The full versioned contract (frontmatter plus the body block and directive grammar) will be exported from @mdp/core and enforced as the conformance test, so the spec and what the engine accepts cannot drift. Do not treat this as the settled schema.

theme.description: A named renderer theme. Never carries colours or sizes. v1 ships one theme.

forms.description: Which presentation forms this source supports / should compile to.

title.description: Optional. Defaults to the first H1 heading in the body.

brand-logo.description: Optional. A brand logo the engine places in the masthead. A URL, a relative path, or a base64 data:image URI. The author supplies only the asset reference; size and position are engine-locked. Unsafe or malformed values are dropped (no logo). Not a color, size, or font.
